title: init: record the Project for the first begin; fetch crates first
prompt:
init: record the Project for the first begin; fetch crates first

A fresh machine following the README stopped twice. cargo build
--offline found no crates: the README, the guide and CONTRIBUTING fetch
them first (cargo fetch --locked), and install.sh fetches and builds
again when its offline build lacks crates. memprove begin --new-task
right after memprove init asked for --project: init now records the
Project it registers, begin reads that record when nothing else names a
Project, and doctor says so before the first begin.
